papers.title_en: HiRAD: A Flexible Large-Scale AGV Routing System
papers.authors: Yunjie Huang, Ruizhong Wu, Mengxuan Zhang, Frodo Kin Sun Chan, Yan Nei Law, Lei Li
papers.evidence: 面向仓储的大规模AGV路由，直接涉及多智能体路径规划与强化学习去中心化策略
papers.tldr: 大规模AGV路由面临组合爆炸与实时性瓶颈：经典多智能体路径规划求解器复杂度高且运动模型理想化，强化学习方案依赖离散时空表示、收敛慢、推理延迟大。HiRAD提出分层强化学习框架，用步级时空表示将连续运动转为可微分问题，分离航向与速度控制缩小动作空间，并以异步事件驱动流水线将推理复杂度从O(n^2)降至O(n)。在随机图与两个仓库地图上，makespan缩短45%-63%，端到端运行时间显著下降，为实时工业控制提供可行方案。
papers.abstract_en: Automatic Guided Vehicles (AGVs) substantially boost warehouse throughput, but routing large-scale AGV fleets remains challenging. Classical Multi-Agent Pathfinding solvers suffer from exploding combinatorial complexity and super-quadratic runtime, while relying on idealized grid or piecewise-linear motion models that mismatch real-world kinematics. Recent Reinforcement Learning (RL) solutions improve flexibility via decentralized agent policies but depend on discretized spatiotemporal representations, require millions of episodes to converge, and incur full-map observation at every step, which leads to large models, slow convergence, and high inference latency that violates real-time industrial control constraints. To address these bottlenecks, we propose HiRAD, a hierarchical RL framework for continuous-space AGV routing with real-time guarantees: (1) a step-level spatiotemporal representation that translates continuous motion into a differentiable RL problem, (2) a hierarchical strategy that splits heading choice from velocity control to reduce the action space, and (3) an asynchronous event-driven decision pipeline that lowers inference complexity from O(n^2) to O(n) and cuts per-step latency by as much as 71 percent. Across random graphs and two warehouse maps, HiRAD reduces makespan by 45 percent to 63 percent and shortens end-to-end runtime.

papers.title_en: Networked Admissibility-Preserving Control for Directed Safe Coordination
papers.authors: Abhinav Sinha, Lohitvel Gopikannan, Shashi Ranjan Kumar
papers.evidence: 基于网络的分布式智能体安全协调与一致性动力学
papers.tldr: 面向标量智能体在有向图、移动安全走廊与异构非对称输入约束下的安全协同，本文提出网络化保可容许控制APC架构：APIR生成物理输入，对数障碍坐标刻画走廊。该架构形成精确级联，指数衰减的实现误差驱动非对称一致性，并给出正负控制需求分别满足执行器边界的充分条件。闭环在兼容紧初始集上具有唯一完备解，保持走廊与执行器区间前向不变、命令有界且指数一致；障碍坐标极限由左Perron向量和初始APIR失配决定，部分钉扎可传播安全参考。
papers.abstract_en: This paper addresses safety-critical coordination for scalar agents whose distributed commands are implemented through constrained physical-input dynamics. Agents communicate over a fixed weighted digraph with a directed spanning tree, while their outputs must remain inside a common moving safety corridor and their realized inputs must satisfy heterogeneous asymmetric bounds. We propose a networked Admissibility-Preserving Control (APC) architecture in which an Admissibility-Preserving Input Realization (APIR) governs physical inputs and a logarithmic barrier coordinate represents the safety corridor. The synthesis yields an exact cascade in which exponentially decaying realization errors drive nonsymmetric consensus dynamics. For every compatible compact initial set, the closed-loop system admits a unique complete solution, renders the moving corridor and actuator intervals forward invariant with uniform margins, keeps commands bounded, and achieves exponential consensus. We derive direction-specific sufficient conditions under which positive and negative control demands remain within their corresponding actuator limits. The analysis yields a closed-form barrier-coordinate limit determined by the left Perron vector and initial APIR mismatch. Under strong connectivity and the stated gain and compatibility conditions, partial pinning propagates a constant barrier reference from a nonempty informed subset and assigns the induced safety corridor trajectory. A non-weight-balanced example illustrates the directional certificate and predicted collective motion.

papers.title_en: Entropy-Regularized Optimal Transport for Time-Varying Multi-Agent Coverage Control
papers.evidence: 基于最优传输的时变多智能体覆盖控制
papers.tldr: 针对多智能体在动态环境中的时变覆盖控制问题，目标密度随时间演化，智能体需在线跟踪并合理分配覆盖资源。本文将问题建模为熵正则化半离散最优传输，以软分配机制替代传统无正则化方法中的硬 Laguerre 划分，从而简化控制律设计和数值求解。基于此提出反馈-前馈控制器，跟踪演化的一阶最优性条件，并证明其指数收敛；同时分析正则化参数，发现超过临界阈值后完全坍缩构型会成为局部最优。数值实验显示，中等正则化下方法性能与无正则化相当，并优于 Voronoi 覆盖基线。
papers.abstract_en: This paper addresses time-varying coverage control for multi-agent systems, formulated as the tracking of an evolving target density via entropy-regularized semi-discrete optimal transport. Unlike the hard Laguerre partition of the unregularized formulation, entropic regularization assigns fractions of the mass at each point to all agents, simplifying the design and numerical implementation of the control law. We derive a feedback-feedforward controller that tracks the evolving first-order optimality conditions with exponential convergence, and we investigate the role of the regularization parameter, which, above a critical threshold, renders the fully collapsed configuration locally optimal. Numerical experiments validate the theory: for moderate regularization, the proposed approach has performance comparable to the unregularized formulation and outperforms the corresponding Voronoi-based coverage baseline.
